'''Tilman Schirmer''' is a [[Structural biology|structural biologist]] and was a Professor at the [[Biozentrum University of Basel|Biozentrum]] of the [[University of Basel]].

== Life ==
Tilman Schirmer studied physics at the [[University of Konstanz]], the [[University of Vienna]], and at [[LMU Munich]]. In 1985, he obtained his doctorate at the [[Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry|Max Planck Institute for Biochemistry]] in [[Martinsried]].<ref name=CV/> He subsequently conducted research at the [[MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology]] in [[Cambridge]], United Kingdom. In 1989, Schirmer joined the [[Biozentrum University of Basel]], initially as a group leader and was appointed as Associate Professor of Structural Biology in 1997. Since 2020, he is an emeritus professor.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/emeriti-former-professors/emeriti/tilman-schirmer/ |title=Prof. Dr. Tilman Schirmer, Emeritus |publisher=Biozentrum.unibas.ch |date= |accessdate=2020-11-03}}</ref>

== Work ==
Schirmer investigates the mechanism of action of bacterial proteins based on their spatial structures, which are determined using [[X-ray crystallography]]. This has provided insights into light harvesting in [[photosynthetic]] antenna complexes, the [[allosteric regulation]] of [[phosphofructokinase]] and the translocation of small [[molecules]] through the porins of the outer [[membrane]].
As of 2013, Schirmer’s research group<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/groups-platforms/overview/unit/schirmer |title=Research group Tilman Schirmer |publisher=Biozentrum.unibas.ch |date= |accessdate=2013-12-03}}</ref> at the Biozentrum in Basel is studying the mechanisms of [[signal transduction]] of the messenger substrate [[cyclic di-GMP]] and the structure-function relationships of bacterial effector proteins with AMP-transferase activity. The goal is the elucidation of fundamental biological interrelationships on the molecular level.<ref name=CV>{{cite web |url=http://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/groups-platforms/eigene-seiten/unit/schirmer/?tx_x4epersdb_pi5%5BshowContentPid%5D=576&cHash=7c53bf9d179cca17956953b1ebf0d720 |title=Projects of the research group Tilman Schirmer |publisher=Biozentrum.unibas.ch |date= |accessdate=2013-12-03}}</ref>
